build.title: Token control plugin: API + MCP + CLI for every token, AmberX tasks/to-dos/notes and the planner, interactive docs

said.text: new plugin, powerful API and MCP and CLI server/client that can change every single token (theme, style, layout); every layout parameter is a token. Connect MCP, API and CLI to Claude and axHub. API and MCP control every aspect of AmberX tasks, to-dos and notes, and the console's planner (Brett: both Plan Studio and the Build orchestrator). Extensive interactive documentation. Folds in the dead VPS build amberx-full-mcp-api (do not relaunch it separately). Overlaps the blocked interactive docs engine (docs-engine/plan.md): reuse it if it lands first.

steps.text: Every layout parameter becomes a token: layout asset type/schema, engine, fixtures (audit what's still literal)
Layout tokens reach every framework component; check-theme flags any layout literal

control@1 contract: one command schema for tokens (list/get/set/reset across theme, style, layout), AmberX entities (tasks, to-dos, notes, everything), planner (Plan Studio plans + orchestrator builds); auth, deletes need confirm
Plugin scaffold token-control: plugin.json, install/uninstall, Settings > Plugins sub-tab, help pack
Server: REST API for tokens; writes go to the axHub appearance document / asset overrides so every app follows
MCP server for tokens; registered as an axHub service and in .mcp.json for Claude
CLI client: axf token list/get/set/reset, plus notes, to-dos, tasks, plans, builds
AmberX API: CRUD for tasks, to-dos, notes and every other AmberX entity (folded in from amberx-full-mcp-api)
AmberX as MCP tools through axHub, deletes confirm
Planner control: Plan Studio plans + orchestrator builds/steps through API, MCP and CLI
Shared JS client library used by the CLI and the console UI
Interactive docs: try-it panels for API, MCP and CLI generated from the control@1 schema
Docs: guides, examples, help packs for every command
Tests, check-theme/check-controls, lifecycle, UI Review shots, PR
